In the state `marching`, on Knight (reserve-2)'s own time (each round Knight (reserve-2) is due, out of a fight), Knight (reserve-2) acts from its own `march` rows.
In the state `marching`, on Knight (reserve-2)'s turn in a fight, Knight (reserve-2) acts from its own `time` rows.
